name: Diamond Quest: Don't Rush!
summary: In Diamond Quest: Don't Rush!, you are an intrepid explorer, pressing deep into the jungles of Angkor Wat temple, the dungeons of Bavaria castle, and the icy Tibet caves. Your quest is collect a series of gems before heading for an exit that leads to the next room. In your adventure, you must cut through leaves, break cobwebs to find the precious jewels.
